notes.title: The Big Update—New Images for George and Bonny
notes.content:
Greetings to all the promoters of purity (or disruptors of purity, depending on your character choice). We are releasing a big and important update today. Images, also known as character skins, have been introduced in the game.

Try them on and turn the speedy cleaning after your dog with poor bowel control into a crazy extravaganza!

Select a skin for your character and post a screenshot in the comment section.
